evidence.detail: rs/q/b is final, implements Runnable, owns one Socket plus InputStream/OutputStream, a circular byte[] write buffer, read/write cursors and writer/error lifecycle flags.
The constructor accepts R48 RSApplet plus Socket, configures socket timeout/TCP_NODELAY/receive-buffer state and captures the socket input/output streams.
The class exposes single-byte read, available-byte count, exact-length blocking read with EOF failure, asynchronous buffered write, orderly close and a writer-thread run loop.
Exact strings include "EOF", "Error closing stream", "Error in writer thread", "buffer overflow" and "ioerror:", directly describing the buffered socket lifecycle.
Buffered writes append into a circular queue; the writer thread is started through RSApplet's runnable scheduler, drains pending bytes to OutputStream and flushes when the queue becomes empty.

proposals.note: RSSocket is the conservative classic semantic identity for this exact buffered threaded socket wrapper; exact v308 behavior is primary evidence.
